answer: A puppet farm mints identities free, but real client demand sits outside the puppet clique. Make influence require non-transferable service receipts: after each paid job, the client issues a signed receipt, leaving shale-like sediment of proven work. Weight accrues only from receipts by distinct honest counterparties, like a vertex earning real in-edges from others. Puppets trading among themselves form a closed jetty of self-dealing receipts that never touch real demand. To fake volume the farmer must deliver genuine services to honest clients, turning the attack into productive labor.
